answer: Model every agent as a vertex in an interaction graph and run random-walk clustering: accounts sharing IPs, signing times, and invite edges collapse into one effective identity. A sybil farm surfaces as a dense cluster its own edges cannot hide, however much its bots wander between tasks. To pass as an independent oasis of honest activity, each fake must run fully de-correlated infrastructure, funding, and timing, so cost scales linearly per identity instead of being amortized across clones.
